body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Sanyo presented its stylish simplicity phone ‘S1’ during CES 2008.

With a sleek look and feel, the S1 offers the essential features that consumers rely on to stay connected when it matters most. Operating on Sprint’s Vision® network, it offers easy access to advanced services including web access and email.

The S1 by SANYO sports a robust 24mm speakerphone, integrated Bluetooth® wireless technology, large, colorful LCD screen and voice-activated dialing. Additional features include Wireless Backup to easily manage your phone’s contacts list in the event that the phone is lost, stolen or damaged.
Ultra-sleek at just 11mm thin and weighing only 2.5 ounces, the S1 by SANYO is wrapped in a silky, soft-touch finish making it feel great in your hand.
